messages:
Priya Iyer: Hey team — urgent. I need to drop my primary shift tonight (00:00-08:00 UTC) due to a family emergency. I can hand off now-ish before 23:30 but won't be reachable after that. I'm primary for eu-night tonight. Incident bot already fired once earlier today (see below). Can someone take primary or be shadowed? I’ll leave notes/runbook pointers in this thread.

SRE Bot: [ALERT] Pager: increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Triggered at 2026-03-14T20:03:40Z. Pager: @oncall-eu-primary.

Alex Chen: I can take primary from 23:00 until 06:00 UTC. Not ideal for full window but I can extend if needed. Can you paste your quick handoff notes?

Priya Iyer: thanks Alex — appreciate it. Quick notes: ongoing small burst of 502s tied to rollout-2026-03-13-ff; suspect model backend oom during heavy long-seq requests. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/eu-api-502 (shortlink). Key commands:
```
# tail app logs for frontend
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=api-frontend --since=30m | tail -n 200
# scale up frontend copy
kubectl -n inference scale deploy api-frontend --replicas=6
# temporarily toggle fallback routing
redwoodctl routing set-policy --region eu-west-1 --fallback-model rwd-small-1b
```
Also watch the autoscaler for GPU flapping; if model loader OOMs, fallback is safer. Customer impact: increased 5xx for ~7% of requests, hitting some low-latency customers (payment flows). Customer support flagged two incidents.

Josh Patel: I can shadow from 00:00-08:00 and be secondary. If Alex is primary that's covered. If Alex can't do full window, I can extend.

Maria Gomez: I’m on vacation but in the timezone and can help if needed between 01:00-03:00 UTC. I can do the bridge if you need a handoff.

Alex Chen: OK I’ll take primary. Plan: 23:00 handoff with Priya, check current rollout, scale up frontend to 6, monitor 5xx, and set a temporary routing fallback if error rate >5% for 5 minutes. I'll post actions and metrics.

Priya Iyer: quick checklist for handoff (I’ll DM credentials where necessary):
- link to active deploy: https://console/releases/rollout/2026-03-13-ff
- open bridge: zoom.us/j/xxxxxxxx (will start at 23:00)
- run simple spike test to reproduce: 50 requests @seq_len=4096 against /v1/generate (use loadtest/send_requests.py)
- escalation: if errors >15% for 10m escalate to eng-platform and create incident channel #incident-eu-api

SRE Bot: [INFO] Auto-scaling events in last hour: frontend replicas 3->5 @2026-03-14T19:45Z, 5->3 @2026-03-14T19:52Z.

Alex Chen: Starting prep now. Running tail logs and will snapshot current pod metrics. If anyone sees an urgent page ping me directly (pings enabled).

Rotation Bot: Note: Priya Iyer was primary for schedule 2026-03-14 00:00-08:00 UTC. Ownership transferred to Alex Chen at 1761115800 pending confirmation.

Josh Patel: Alex — do you want me to take over primary at 03:00 if you need sleep? I can be on-call quiet shift from 03:00-10:00 UTC.

Alex Chen: Appreciated. I'll try to cover until 06:00 and then hand to Josh if still needed.

Maria Gomez: If you hit the fallback route, remember to disable it after rollout revert to avoid serving a lower-capacity model for long. I’ll remind you at 02:30 if I'm on.

Priya Iyer: One more: customer impact note to paste to #support-escalations if pages increase:
"We’re seeing an elevated 5xx rate on generation in eu-west-1 tied to an in-progress model rollout. Engineers are scaling frontend and routing to a smaller model as a temporary fallback. Customers may see intermittent errors or lower-capacity responses. ETA: 60-90m for recovery updates."

Alex Chen: Update at 23:12 UTC — scaled frontend to 6, no immediate OOM on new pods, 5xx rate reduced from 7% -> 3.2% over 10m. Keeping routing baseline for now. Will monitor for 30m and re-evaluate.

SRE Bot: [ALERT] New pager at 23:39 UTC — spike in latency on kv-cache-populate. Affected: subset of long-seq requests.

Alex Chen: Noted. Trying to reproduce locally. If latency keeps spiking, plan B is to enable prefix caching for long sequences and reduce max_sequence default to 2048 for a short window.

Josh Patel: If you flip max_seq, add a banner to #platform-change-log and ping support so they can message affected customers.

Alex Chen: Will do. Handoff notes posted to PagerDuty incident and bridge opened. Priya — safe travels, thanks for leaving notes.

Priya Iyer: thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick volunteers. I’ll follow up tomorrow AM if all good. :pray:
